title: AlertPayload
description: Canonical threat and anomaly alert payload contract emitted upon detection and consumed by actuator-security and web-dashboard.

alert_id.description: Unique UUID identifying the detection alert.

timestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the alert was triggered.

source_service.description: Originating microservice of the anomalous edge.

target_service.description: Destination microservice of the anomalous edge.

severity.description: Severity level of the threat or degradation.

quarantine_target.description: Service identified for automated quarantine containment (typically source_service).

confidence.description: Confidence score of the ML inference detection.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the anomaly detection.

components.description: Optional breakdown of scoring feature components.

inference_ms.description: Execution latency of ML inference in milliseconds.
